comparison.objective: Place two equal tubes in opposite centrifuge pockets; candidate adjusts and locks a gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Safety-rule selection and upright tube pick-and-place versus precision threaded adjustment, tool regrasping, and countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: Requires both tubes seated 180° apart; partial credit only for exactly one safely seated tube, with no finer release rubric specified.
comparison.reason: Balanced placement based on rotor symmetry is unrelated to the candidate's coupled screw/nut mechanics and retained-cycle outcome.
